key_insight: SyncFix enforces cross‑view consistency by jointly synchronizing distorted and clean latent representations across multiple views during diffusion‑based refinement, allowing the model to correct semantic and geometric errors in 3D reconstructions.
problem_solved: Fixes semantic and geometric inconsistencies and view‑dependent artifacts in multi‑view 3D reconstructions that arise during refinement, reducing misalignments and hallucinations across camera views.
method: Formulate refinement as a joint latent bridge matching problem that couples distorted and clean representations across views.
Learn a joint conditional diffusion denoising process over multiple views so consistency is enforced throughout the entire denoising trajectory.
Train using only image pairs (data‑efficient) while applying the learned multi‑view synchronization to improve reconstructed scenes.
impact: Enables more coherent, realistic 3D reconstructions with fewer cross‑view artifacts, improving downstream tasks (rendering, editing, AR/VR) and integrating into existing diffusion‑based refinement pipelines with modest data needs.
visual_elements: Pipeline diagram: multiple input views → joint latent bridge matching → synchronized diffusion denoising → consistent 3D reconstruction (before vs after).
Before/after comparison: same scene rendered from several views showing corrected geometry and semantics.
Sequence illustration: denoising timesteps showing how cross‑view latents stay synchronized over the trajectory.
Bar/line chart: quantitative metrics (cross‑view error, artifact rate) comparing baseline vs SyncFix.
paper_title: SyncFix: Fixing 3D Reconstructions via Multi-View Synchronization
paper_authors: Deming Li, Abhay Yadav, Cheng Peng, Rama Chellappa, Anand Bhattad
